business.description: Gloster Limited is a jute manufacturing company with over 150 years of heritage, operating integrated jute mills in Bauria, Howrah, West Bengal. It manufactures jute textiles, yarns, geotextiles, lifestyle products, home decor, and retail products under the PATSAN brand.

outlook.statement: Gloster remains committed to carrying the legacy of the Golden Fibre to global markets through innovation, quality, and customer-centricity, with strategic clarity, operational excellence, ethical conduct, and unwavering commitment to creating long-term value for all stakeholders.

The retail business is expected to play a pivotal role in driving value-added growth, increasing brand visibility, and positioning jute as a preferred sustainable lifestyle material for the modern consumer.

PATSAN is expected to play a pivotal role in enhancing market visibility, expanding customer reach, and creating a differentiated platform for sustainable products inspired by the enduring legacy of jute.

Raw Jute crop is estimated to be significantly higher due to higher area under cultivation and better yield; prices will remain at elevated levels compared to previous years but lower than present level. Exports have seen further de-growth largely due to unprecedented increase in prices of finished goods apart from the effect of wars affecting all export markets. The Company continued its efforts to expand its presence in new domestic and international markets and strengthen its portfolio of diversified and value-added jute products.

Demand from Government is expected to be very strong. With the prices correcting, the Company hopes to win back some of the export markets lost to Bangladesh. The Company remains focused on improving operational efficiency, enhancing productivity, optimising costs and increasing the share of value-added products while expanding its presence in domestic and international markets.

The global jute industry is witnessing renewed interest driven by shift toward biodegradable alternatives to synthetics, regulatory restrictions on single-use plastics, and diversification into value-added products (geo-textiles, shopping bags, composites, lifestyle products). Gloster remains focused on expanding higher value applications across geo textiles, agro textiles, sustainable packaging, insulation, and lifestyle segments, supported by targeted research, innovation, and partnerships.
The Company believes that greater availability of organic jute in the market and increased procurement of such material may further reduce the environmental footprint of its products.

Evaluating feasibility of Zero Liquid Discharge systems at key units; developing comprehensive business continuity and disaster management plan; developing ESG assessment checklist for supplier due diligence; evaluating digitalization of customer and back-office processes and developing cybersecurity framework
Fort Gloster Industries Ltd. expects FY2026-27 to be the first year for operations at normal capacity after completing major capitalisation of the project during current year.

Salary growth risk: The present value of the defined benefit obligation is calculated by reference to the future salaries of plan participants. Higher than expected increases in salary will increase the defined benefit obligation.
